# 物种组成分析

## 载入包

```{r}
#| label: taxonomy-load-packages
library(tidyverse)
library(microeco)
library(patchwork)
library(jsonlite)
library(scales)
source("figure-notes.R")

theme_set(theme_bw())
```

## 构建 microtable 对象

```{r}
#| label: taxonomy-create-microtable
otu_table <- read.csv("data/amplicon-sequencing/otu_table_mt.csv", row.names = 1, check.names = FALSE)
sample_table <- read.csv("data/amplicon-sequencing/sample_table_mt.csv", row.names = 1, check.names = FALSE) |>
    mutate(
        group = factor(group, levels = c("A", "B", "C")),
        breed = factor(breed, levels = c("Duroc", "Landrace", "Yorkshire")),
        genotype = factor(genotype, levels = c("AA", "GA", "GG"))
    )
taxon_table <- read.csv("data/amplicon-sequencing/taxon_table_mt.csv", row.names = 1, check.names = FALSE)

# 剔除 NA 分类
taxon_table = subset(taxon_table, !is.na(Phylum))

mt <- microtable$new(otu_table = otu_table, sample_table = sample_table, tax_table = taxon_table)
mt$tidy_dataset()
```

## 高丰度属差异

```{r}
#| label: prepare-genus-box-data
mt$cal_abund()

extract_genus_name <- function(x) {
    x |>
        str_extract("(^|\\|)g__[^|]*$") |>
        str_remove("^\\|") |>
        str_remove("^g__") |>
        str_replace_all("_", " ") |>
        na_if("")
}

is_meaningful_genus <- function(x) {
    !is.na(x) &
        !str_detect(str_to_lower(x), "unclassified|uncultured|unknown|metagenome|norank|ambiguous") &
        !str_detect(x, "^[A-Z]+[-_ ]?\\d") &
        !str_detect(x, "\\bgroup\\b")
}

top8_genus <- mt$taxa_abund$Genus |>
    as.data.frame(check.names = FALSE) |>
    rownames_to_column("Genus") |>
    mutate(Genus_name = extract_genus_name(Genus)) |>
    filter(is_meaningful_genus(Genus_name)) |>
    mutate(mean_abundance = rowMeans(pick(where(is.numeric)), na.rm = TRUE)) |>
    slice_max(mean_abundance, n = 8, with_ties = FALSE) |>
    arrange(desc(mean_abundance)) |>
    mutate(Genus_clean = str_trunc(Genus_name, width = 18)) |>
    mutate(
        Genus_clean = if_else(
            duplicated(Genus_clean) | duplicated(Genus_clean, fromLast = TRUE),
            paste0(Genus_clean, " ", row_number()),
            Genus_clean
        )
    )

genus_abundance_data <- mt$taxa_abund$Genus |>
    as.data.frame(check.names = FALSE) |>
    rownames_to_column("Genus") |>
    pivot_longer(-Genus, names_to = "sample", values_to = "abundance") |>
    left_join(
        mt$sample_table |> as.data.frame() |> rownames_to_column("sample"),
        by = "sample"
    )

genus_box_data <- genus_abundance_data |>
    semi_join(top8_genus, by = "Genus") |>
    left_join(top8_genus |> select(Genus, Genus_name, mean_abundance, Genus_clean), by = "Genus") |>
    mutate(Genus_clean = factor(Genus_clean, levels = top8_genus$Genus_clean))

significance_label <- function(p) {
    case_when(
        p < 0.001 ~ "***",
        p < 0.01 ~ "**",
        p < 0.05 ~ "*",
        TRUE ~ NA_character_
    )
}

pairwise_significance <- function(data, group_var) {
    group_levels <- levels(droplevels(data[[group_var]]))
    comparisons <- combn(group_levels, 2, simplify = FALSE)
    empty_result <- tibble(
        group1 = character(),
        group2 = character(),
        p_value = numeric(),
        p_adjust = numeric(),
        label = character(),
        Genus_clean = factor(levels = levels(data$Genus_clean)),
        x = numeric(),
        xend = numeric(),
        y = numeric(),
        y_text = numeric(),
        tick = numeric()
    )

    result <- map_dfr(levels(data$Genus_clean), function(genus_name) {
        genus_data <- data |> filter(Genus_clean == genus_name)
        y_range <- range(genus_data$abundance, na.rm = TRUE)
        y_span <- diff(y_range)
        if (!is.finite(y_span) || y_span == 0) {
            y_span <- max(y_range[2], 0.01)
        }

        tests <- map_dfr(comparisons, function(pair) {
            x1 <- genus_data |> filter(.data[[group_var]] == pair[1]) |> pull(abundance)
            x2 <- genus_data |> filter(.data[[group_var]] == pair[2]) |> pull(abundance)

            tibble(
                group1 = pair[1],
                group2 = pair[2],
                p_value = wilcox.test(x1, x2, exact = FALSE)$p.value
            )
        }) |>
            mutate(
                p_adjust = p.adjust(p_value, method = "BH"),
                label = significance_label(p_adjust)
            ) |>
            filter(!is.na(label)) |>
            arrange(p_adjust)

        if (nrow(tests) == 0) {
            return(empty_result)
        }

        tests |>
            mutate(
                Genus_clean = genus_name,
                x = match(group1, group_levels),
                xend = match(group2, group_levels),
                y = y_range[2] + y_span * (0.04 + row_number() * 0.055),
                y_text = y + y_span * 0.018,
                tick = y_span * 0.018
            )
    })

    bind_rows(empty_result, result) |>
        mutate(Genus_clean = factor(Genus_clean, levels = levels(data$Genus_clean)))
}

plot_top8_genus_box <- function(group_var, x_label) {
    sig_data <- pairwise_significance(genus_box_data, group_var)

    genus_box_data |>
        ggplot(aes(x = .data[[group_var]], y = abundance, fill = .data[[group_var]])) +
        geom_boxplot(outlier.shape = NA, alpha = 0.75, width = 0.65) +
        geom_jitter(width = 0.16, size = 1, alpha = 0.5) +
        geom_segment(
            data = sig_data,
            aes(x = x, xend = xend, y = y, yend = y),
            inherit.aes = FALSE
        ) +
        geom_segment(
            data = sig_data,
            aes(x = x, xend = x, y = y - tick, yend = y),
            inherit.aes = FALSE
        ) +
        geom_segment(
            data = sig_data,
            aes(x = xend, xend = xend, y = y - tick, yend = y),
            inherit.aes = FALSE
        ) +
        geom_text(
            data = sig_data,
            aes(x = (x + xend) / 2, y = y_text, label = label),
            inherit.aes = FALSE,
            size = 3.5
        ) +
        facet_wrap(~ Genus_clean, scales = "free_y", ncol = 4) +
        scale_y_continuous(labels = percent_format(accuracy = 0.1), expand = expansion(mult = c(0.04, 0.14))) +
        labs(x = x_label, y = "Relative abundance") +
        theme(
            legend.position = "none",
            strip.text = element_text(face = "italic"),
            axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 30, hjust = 1)
        )
}
```

```{r}
#| label: tbl-top8-genus
#| echo: false
top8_genus |>
    transmute(
        Genus = Genus_clean,
        Mean_relative_abundance = mean_abundance
    ) |>
    knitr::kable(
        digits = 4,
        caption = "全体样本中平均相对丰度最高的 8 个已命名属。"
    )
```

```{r}
#| label: fig-genus-box-breed
#| fig-width: 11
#| fig-height: 6.5
#| fig-cap: "全体样本平均相对丰度最高的 8 个已命名属在不同品种中的相对丰度分布。每个面板对应一个属，箱线图概括组内分布，散点代表单个样本；横线和星号表示两两 Wilcoxon 秩和检验经 BH 校正后仍显著的组间差异，*、**、*** 分别表示校正后 P < 0.05、0.01、0.001。"
plot_top8_genus_box("breed", "Breed")
```


```{r}
#| label: note-genus-box-breed
#| echo: false
#| results: asis
render_figure_note("genus-box-breed")
```

```{r}
#| label: fig-genus-box-genotype
#| fig-width: 11
#| fig-height: 6.5
#| fig-cap: "全体样本平均相对丰度最高的 8 个已命名属在不同 FUT1 基因型中的相对丰度分布。属的选择基于样本平均相对丰度排序，并剔除未分类、未培养、unknown、norank、group 等难以解释的标签；显著性标注来自每个属内 AA、GA、GG 两两 Wilcoxon 秩和检验及 BH 多重检验校正。"
plot_top8_genus_box("genotype", "FUT1 genotype")
```


```{r}
#| label: note-genus-box-genotype
#| echo: false
#| results: asis
render_figure_note("genus-box-genotype")
```
